== Notes ==
* This skill will remove existing Blindness when applied, although this is not stated in its description. This is similar to other [[Skill quick reference#Skills that provide immunity to a condition|skills that provide immunity to a condition]], except for [[Frigid Armor]].
* When used with [[Spirit's Strength]], it functions both as a good [[cover]] enchantment and an insurance against being Blinded.

== Trivia ==
* This skill has changed since its introduction; see its [[/Skill history|skill history]] for details.
* ''"Sight Beyond Sight"'' is the main ability of the Sword of Omens, the primary weapon used by [[w:Lion-O|Lion-O]], one of the main characters from the 1980s cartoon series [[W:ThunderCats|ThunderCats]].
